connector.name: Render Useful MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Render Public API: all 207 endpoints plus workflow tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package render-useful-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lusrodri account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RENDER_WORKSPACE_ID
env.description: Default workspace, applied wherever a tool needs an ownerId and the caller omitted one.

env.name: RENDER_MCP_TOOLSETS
env.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose, or 'all'. Defaults to all 17 toolsets.

env.name: RENDER_MCP_DYNAMIC_TOOLSETS
env.description: Registers the render_toolsets tool, which reports which toolsets exist and which are enabled.
